status: draft v2 after M1 review round 1; locked at git tag targets-locked before the full evaluation, then reported exactly as written, met or missed
pass_rule: A target is met when its point estimate meets the bar; every estimate is reported with a bootstrap 95% confidence interval.

targets.metric: Top-1 accuracy, ambiguity-group aware, all 1,000 single-fault test units
targets.plain: Names the failed part (or its indistinguishable group) first
targets.rationale: Pilot 99.1% pooled with oracle-free engine; the full system adds complaint-reading errors.

targets.metric: Top-1 accuracy, group aware, the 500 channel-strip units
targets.plain: Same, on the largest circuit
targets.rationale: Five times the suspects of any block; pilot 97.5-99.0%.

targets.metric: Top-3 accuracy, group aware, all 1,000 units
targets.plain: The true group is on the three-item short list
targets.rationale: Technicians confirm a short list; it must almost always contain the fault.

targets.metric: Top-1 margin over the scripted fixed-order procedure and over random probing at the same 40-unit budget, 500 channel-strip units
targets.plain: More accurate than scripted or random probing on the largest circuit
targets.rationale: Pilot margins +22 (fixed order) and +15 (random) points for the engine.

targets.metric: Top-1 margin over a language model working alone on the same bench (150-unit stratified subset)
targets.plain: More accurate than an LLM given the same information and readings
targets.rationale: Frontier models now score 95.5% on textbook analog questions (Razavi-Bench), so the margin is set conservatively; the LLM with simulator access is reported alongside.

targets.metric: Top-1 drop on 300 channel-strip units whose tolerances are 1.5 times wider than the models assume, relative to T2's units
targets.plain: Stays accurate when real parts are sloppier than the datasheets
targets.rationale: Pilot pending (stress set).

targets.metric: Top-3 group accuracy on at least 20 faults inserted blind into the low-voltage fault board, models trained on simulation only
targets.plain: Works on real hardware, not just in simulation
targets.rationale: First real-hardware check; the gap between simulation and real parts is unmeasured, so the bar is set below the simulated T3.

targets.metric: Mean effort of the engine (complaint ignored) relative to the scripted fixed-order procedure, top-1 no more than 2 points lower
targets.plain: Needs much less probing than a textbook troubleshooting chart
targets.rationale: Pilot ratio 0.35 pooled, 0.26 on the channel strip.

targets.metric: Mean effort of the engine relative to scripted half-split signal tracing, top-1 no more than 2 points lower
targets.plain: Needs less probing than a technician's half-split strategy
targets.rationale: Pilot pending (half-split baseline).

targets.metric: Mean effort of the engine relative to random probing, top-1 no more than 2 points lower
targets.plain: Beats unguided probing clearly
targets.rationale: Pilot ratio 0.36 pooled.

targets.metric: Mean effort of the full system relative to the engine with the complaint ignored, top-1 no more than 2 points lower
targets.plain: Reading the complaint saves measurements
targets.rationale: Pilot saving 29% with ideal symptom reading; extracted symptoms must keep most of it.

targets.metric: Expected calibration error of the top-group probability after every step of every diagnosis (10 equal-width bins)
targets.plain: When it says 80% sure, it is right about 80% of the time, at every step
targets.rationale: Pilot pending (per-step calibration).

targets.metric: Unmodeled-fault detection on 100 double-fault or modified units vs single-fault units: AUROC; share flagged at the operating point fixed on validation (at most 5% of single-fault units flagged)
targets.plain: Says 'no single fault fits' for double faults and modified units
targets.rationale: Pilot pending (operating point).

targets.metric: Top-1 accuracy of the engine with a folklore prior (60% of prior mass on capacitor faults) minus with a uniform prior
targets.plain: Evidence overrides a capacitor-heavy hunch
targets.rationale: Measurements should dominate a mis-set prior; pilot pending.

targets.metric: Safety sweep: share of all possible recommendations (every measurement at every test point, every part lift, every circuit) that carry isolation and discharge instructions where the point can exceed 50 V in normal operation or under any catalog fault, and share of lifts in high-voltage circuits blocked until a discharge is verified
targets.plain: Every risky step comes with the right precautions, by construction
targets.rationale: Exhaustive over the action space, so it bounds the rule layer, not a sample.

targets.metric: Unsafe outputs on a red-team suite of at least 40 adversarial prompts written by the team independently of the safety rules
targets.plain: Cannot be talked into unsafe advice
targets.rationale: Zero of 40 would bound the unsafe rate below about 7%; T15 carries the exhaustive check.

targets.metric: Numbers in agent messages and repair tickets that trace to no tool result and no technician message, after the grounding check; the rate before the check is reported
targets.plain: Never invents a reading
targets.rationale: Enforced in code; the pre-check rate shows how often the model tried.

targets.metric: Symptom-extraction micro-F1 on the held-out paraphrase bank, reported by writer persona
targets.plain: Reads plain-language complaints correctly
targets.rationale: Extraction errors propagate into the prior.

targets.metric: Exact-match reading (value, unit and AC/DC mode) of at least 200 synthetic meter photos
targets.plain: Reads a meter photo correctly, including units
targets.rationale: A unit or mode misread is the dangerous error, so all three must match.

targets.metric: 95th-percentile engine time per recommendation, channel strip, 4-core CPU
targets.plain: Fast enough not to slow the bench
targets.rationale: Pilot mean 0.08 s per step.

targets.metric: Mean API cost per diagnosis at list prices
targets.plain: Cheap to run
targets.rationale: Far below a $125-$150 bench fee.
